what: A chat message typed in a job's own chat (message.job_id, the job in data.job) gets one line in the prompt: it is about that job, a running background job cannot read it, so the chat run answers it as a message about that job; an answer to messages of ONE job goes into that job's chat (job_id on the answer); an older server or a job that is gone (400 / 404 / 409): the same answer without job_id
